raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
Add vllm-iluvatar plugin to the non-official hardware plugin list.



## Overview

Add vllm-iluvatar to the list of non-official vLLM hardware plugins.

## Claims

- Document vllm-iluvatar as a non-official hardware plugin for Iluvatar CoreX GPUs.
- Link to the open-source plugin repository.

## Validation

- `pre-commit run --files docs/design/custom_op.md` — passed.

## Details

[vllm-iluvatar](https://github.com/Deep-Spark/vllm-iluvatar) is out-of-tree vLLM plugin for [Iluvatar CoreX](https://www.iluvatar.com) GPUs. Deep-Spark is Iluvatar CoreX's open-source organization in GitHub.
The plugin currently supports vLLM v0.27.1, and support for v0.31.0 is in progress. We will keep it aligned with vLLM's roadmap and release cadence.

---

<summary> Pull Request Checklist </summary>

- [x] I used vLLM's `/pr-checklist` skill. (Mandatory for agents, optional for humans).
- [x] AI assistance was used during the creation of this PR.

- [x] **Design Fit:** Minimizes impact on core components, reuses existing functionality, and justifies added complexity.
- [x] **Testing and Validation:** Validates the change and ensures any added tests are meaningful and reliable, with CI coverage or documented CI resource constraints and validation performed outside CI.
- [x] **Code Quality and Style:** Keeps code and comments clear and concise, and updates relevant documentation and examples.
- [x] **Pull Request Contents:** Includes a brief summary and relevant links, supports claims with evidence, explains root causes and implementation trade-offs, and follows the contributing guide.
</details>

@hmellor  Hi, this PR only adds vllm-iluvatar to the hardware plugin list in the docs. Could you add the `verified` label so the docs build can run? Thank you.

Below is the vllm-iluvatar plugin running log of Qwen3.8-27B-W8A8 on Iluvatar CoreX GPUs. If there's anything more I need to do, just let me know, Thanks a lot!

```bash
# Environment
pip list | grep vllm
vllm                                     0.27.1
vllm_iluvatar                            0.27.1

# Serve command
vllm serve ./Qwen3.8-27B-W8A8-compressed-tensors --tensor-parallel-size 2 --pipeline-parallel-size 1 --trust-remote-code --compilation-config {"cudagraph_mode":"FULL_DECODE_ONLY","mode":0} --max-model-len 16384 --port 30000 --served-model-name Qwen3.8-27B-W8A8

# Load vllm-iluvatar plugin
INFO 09-17 16:34:23 [__init__.py:52] Available plugins for group vllm.platform_plugins:
INFO 09-17 16:34:23 [__init__.py:54] - iluvatar -> vllm_iluvatar:register_platform
INFO 09-17 16:34:23 [__init__.py:57] All plugins in this group will be loaded. Set `VLLM_PLUGINS` to control which plugins to load.
INFO 09-17 16:34:23 [__init__.py:237] Platform plugin iluvatar is activated
```

Detail log can be seen in [this gistfile](https://gist.github.com/rexlee8776/d3458c7ff3c8ff4e59efca910a93f1bf).
I'll merge soon, we just need to fix the docs build on main first
@hmellor Thank you! After this merge, I've emailed website-feedback@vllm.ai to request adding Iluvatar CoreX (Iluvatar GPU) to https://vllm.ai/#compatibility.

## Claude Code Review

This pull request is from a fork — automated review is disabled. A repository maintainer can comment `@claude review` to run a one-time review.

files.patch:
@@ -264,7 +264,7 @@ Currently, thanks to [vLLM's hardware-plugin mechanism](./plugin_system.md), the
 
 - **Official device plugins:** [vllm-ascend](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend) (for Huawei Ascend NPU), [vllm-spyre](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-spyre)
 (for Spyre), [vllm-gaudi](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-gaudi) (for Intel Gaudi), [vllm-neuron](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-neuron) (for AWS Neuron), [vllm-meta](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-metal) (for Apple Silicon), etc.
-- **Non-official device plugins:** [vllm-metax](https://github.com/MetaX-MACA/vLLM-metax) (for MetaX GPU), [vllm-kunlun](https://github.com/baidu/vLLM-Kunlun) (for Baidu Kunlun XPU), [vllm-musa](https://github.com/MooreThreads/vllm-musa) (for Moore Threads GPU), etc.
+- **Non-official device plugins:** [vllm-metax](https://github.com/MetaX-MACA/vLLM-metax) (for MetaX GPU), [vllm-kunlun](https://github.com/baidu/vLLM-Kunlun) (for Baidu Kunlun XPU), [vllm-musa](https://github.com/MooreThreads/vllm-musa) (for Moore Threads GPU), [vllm-iluvatar](https://github.com/Deep-Spark/vllm-iluvatar) (for Iluvatar CoreX GPU), etc.
 
 In this case, `CustomOp` can enable these hardware manufacturers to seamlessly replace vLLM's operations with their deep-optimized kernels for specific devices at runtime, by just registering an OOT `CustomOp` and implementing the `forward_oot()` method.
